# Ecosystems with the Frontend

The Verana Frontend is where a corporation administers what it controls: its members and operators, its ecosystems and governance frameworks, its credential schemas, the participants it accredits, its trust deposit.

| Guide | Status |
|---|---|
| The ecosystem builder's path | coming |
| Create a corporation; operators, proposals and fee grants; corporation governance framework | coming |
| Create an ecosystem and publish its governance framework; run the ecosystem anchor | coming |
| Define a credential schema; root participants and grantors | coming |
| Validate applicants; revoke, slash and repay | coming |
| Design the fee model | coming |
| Offer identity schemas for your sector | coming |

Until these guides land, the command-line pages under [Reference, command line (legacy)](../../reference/cli/index.md) describe the same operations message by message.
